name: Kislon
title: Father of Eldad, prince of the tribe of Benjamin
summary: Kislon is a person mentioned in Numbers as the father of Eldad (also called Elidad in some translations). His son was appointed to represent the tribe of Benjamin in the distribution of the land of Canaan. Kislon himself played no direct role in the account but is known through his son who was given responsibility in the land allocation.

keyEvents.title: Kislon's son appointed for land distribution
keyEvents.description: God commanded Moses to appoint leaders from each tribe to distribute the land of Canaan. Elidad, son of Kislon, was chosen to represent the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: God's command regarding land distribution
keyEvents.description: The Lord spoke to Moses and gave instructions on how the land of Canaan should be distributed among the tribes of Israel, with representatives from each tribe participating.

keyEvents.title: List of tribal princes for land distribution
keyEvents.description: Moses received a complete list of men who were to assist Eleazar the priest and Joshua in dividing the inheritance, including Elidad, son of Kislon, for Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Preparations for entering Canaan
keyEvents.description: In the preparations for the conquest and distribution of the promised land, an arrangement was established where each tribe had a representative, giving Kislon's family an important role.
